results.controlIntent: a. Conduct a risk assessment, including: 1. Identifying threats to and vulnerabilities in the system; 2. Determining the likelihood and magnitude of harm from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, disruption, modification, or destruction of the system, the information it processes, stores, or transmits, and any related information; and 3. Determining the likelihood and impact of adverse effects on individuals arising from the processing of personally identifiable information; b. Integrate, with system-level risk assessments, risk assessment results and risk management decisions from the organization and mission or business process perspectives; c. Document risk assessment results in [Selection: security and privacy plans; risk assessment report; [Assignment: organization-defined document]]; d. Review risk assessment results [Assignment: organization-defined frequency]; e. Disseminate risk assessment results to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]; and f. Update the risk assessment [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] or when there are significant changes to the system, its environment of operation, or other conditions that may impact the security or privacy state of the system.

judgment.rationale:
The only available evidence collector — getModelCard — returned null, indicating that no model card exists for "churn-predictor-v1" / "churn-predictor-endpoint". A model card is the primary artifact expected to document risk assessment results for an ML model (covering intended use, limitations, risk ratings, and evaluation details). Its complete absence means there is no evidence of any of the six RA-3 sub-requirements being met:

(a) No documented risk assessment identifying threats, vulnerabilities, likelihood/magnitude of harm, or PII-related adverse effects.
(b) No evidence of integration with organizational or mission-level risk management decisions.
(c) No documented risk assessment results in any recognized form (security/privacy plan, risk assessment report, or equivalent).
(d) No evidence of periodic review of risk assessment results.
(e) No evidence of dissemination of risk assessment results to defined personnel or roles.
(f) No evidence of a process to update the risk assessment on a defined frequency or upon significant system changes.

Without a model card or any other retrievable documentation, the control is not satisfied.
gaps: No model card exists for churn-predictor-v1 — the getModelCard collector returned null, so there is no retrievable evidence of a risk assessment having been conducted, documented, reviewed, disseminated, or updated.

Human attestation would be needed to determine whether a risk assessment exists in an external system (e.g., a GRC tool, SharePoint, or separate risk register) that is not surfaced by the available collectors.

Evidence of organizational-level risk integration (RA-3.b), review cadence (RA-3.d), dissemination list (RA-3.e), and update triggers (RA-3.f) cannot be assessed without additional tooling or human attestation.
